THE LAW, SHORT FORM
Faces: Tiro (Devanagari) · Cinzel (English display caps) · Inter (body). Nothing else.
Color: literals live only on token lines in system.css — palette canon + effect registry. Everywhere else, var().
Accent law: essential text — land: tamra · halls/walk: ink · sanctum: gold on mahakala. Gold is decorative-only outside mahakala.
Language: lang="sa" on Sanskrit, lang="hi" on Hindi — by language, not script.
Motion: one grammar, contraction toward Him; budget increases with depth; the land is stillest. One dominant action per view.
Depth: the gauge morphs once per crossing — chakra → anāhata → bindu. The sanctum has no footer and no OFFER.
